The plan's own spec says hierarchy judges the slides deck, fails the same way on lectures 16, 17 and 19, and is outside the write surface. The redCommand is the whole check.sh gate, so its exit code stays 1 whatever r18-style does. The near-duplicate listings in the output are advisory text, not failing legs: the gate names only hierarchy. The second numbered failure in the digest has the same cause.
routes.fix: Amend the plan. Either make r18-style's redCommand a gate that excludes the hierarchy leg (for example, a wrapper that greps the 'failing leg(s)' list for anything other than hierarchy), or drop the redCommand. A notes task cannot turn an exit-1 deck leg green, and editing the deck is forbidden.
